text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: HAHA! Don't worry at all, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"An injury like this is SO small compared 
to the BIG me! Just like this room!"
choice_data_list: Still, I'm worried, so let's rest.
Let's not say that, and just be careful.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san. Thank you for worrying 
about me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Just that thought alone makes me feel 
totally energized! Look, it doesn't hurt 
at aaall anymore—"

After finishing the treatment, I decided 
to have her rest for the day.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Mooo... Trainer, you worry too much, yes! 
Me is really, truly fine!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: See, even if I run, it's no proble—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Rooms in Nihon really are so small yo~...

After tending to her new injuries, I 
decided to have her rest for the rest of 
the day.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, it is possible that I have 
lacked focus recently, yes."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Carelessness in training is the ultimate 
enemy...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So we don't get hurt again, we must BANG! 
that big enemy, yes!

After finishing the treatment, I decided 
to resume training at Taiki Shuttle's 
request.
